column1: # implfile-retirements.tsv — implFiles entries that leave registry.json on purpose. HAND-MAINTAINED; pipeline.mjs reads it.
# implFiles only grows: build-registry.mjs carries the prior list forward and apply-status.mjs appends each status row's
# column 3. A deleted file therefore stays named as a frame's implementation forever, and so does every placeholder a
# row wrote in column 3. pipeline.mjs drops each entry listed here right after apply-status, and refuses any OTHER
# implFiles entry leaving a surviving frame (exit 2). Before anything runs it refuses the whole table (exit 1) if a
# row is malformed or if any path in a listed entry still exists under the Skai-Trading checkout: this table retires
# files that are gone, never a live file. Outside a checkout (a scratch export) it says the paths were not checked.
# frame   a registry frame key, or * for every frame that carries the entry
# entry   the implFiles entry exactly as registry.json stores it
# date    YYYY-MM-DD the row was written
# reason  the commit that removed the file, or why the entry names no file; who found it
# Added 2026-09-24 (wave 67, w67-cat-verdicts) from the stale entries w67-cat-status-a and w67-cat-status-b reported;
# frame counts are at skai-ui f438e6f.
